topic: 字母、声音与自我介绍 · Independent new scenario: a visitor help desk with corrected room details
grammarFocus: 人称代词 I / you；be 动词 am / are；句首大写与句号。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: The Visitor Help Desk
instructions: 这是为A0初学者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思测试）。请先阅读短文，注意句首大写和句号。然后完成8道阅读题。之后学习语法：人称代词 I / you 和 be 动词 am / are。最后完成语法练习和口语写作任务。所有题目用英语作答。
passage: A: Hello. I am a visitor. You are at the help desk. B: Yes. I am Ben. You are a visitor. You are welcome. A: I am at Room 4. You are at Room 6. B: No. I am at Room 6. You are at Room 5. Room 5 is your room. A: Thank you. I am at Room 5. You are at Room 6. B: Yes. I am Ben. You are a visitor. Room 5 is your room. Room 6 is my room. I help visitors at the help desk. You are a visitor, so I help you. Room 5 is your room. Room 6 is my room. Thank you.

questions.explanation: B明确说“I am Ben.”，同一轮说话又说“I help visitors at the help desk.”，所以帮助访客的人是Ben。选项均为人名；题目不再把“在服务台”误当作只有一人的位置。
questions.evidence: B: Yes. I am Ben. You are a visitor. Room 5 is your room. Room 6 is my room. I help visitors at the help desk.

questions.explanation: 文中B说“Room 5 is your room.”，访客的房间是5号。
文中B说“Room 6 is my room.”，Ben的房间是6号。

questions.prompt: Which room does the visitor mention first?
questions.explanation: 题目问访客最先提到哪间房。访客先说“I am at Room 4.”，后来才被纠正为Room 5；这里直接定位最先说出的房号。
questions.evidence: A: I am at Room 4. You are at Room 6.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the text: 'You are at the help ____.'
questions.explanation: 原句是“You are at the help desk.”，help后缺少的一个词为desk。题干不再提供Ben这个标准答案，也不重复姓名题。
questions.evidence: You are at the help desk.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the text: 'You are a ____.'
questions.explanation: 文中B说“You are a visitor.”，所以填visitor。

questions.prompt: Which sentence has the correct capital letters?
questions.explanation: 句首字母I要大写，名字Ben也要大写，句末有句号。

questions.prompt: What does A say after B says 'No'?
questions.explanation: B说“No”并纠正房号后，下一轮A先说“Thank you.”。明确限定说话顺序，不把最后由B说出的文字误标为访客结尾。
questions.evidence: A: Thank you. I am at Room 5. You are at Room 6.

vocabulary.example: You are at the help desk.
You are at the help desk.

grammar.title: 人称代词 I / you 与 be 动词 am / are
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，I 表示“我”，you 表示“你”。be 动词 am 和 I 连用，are 和 you 连用。句子开头第一个字母要大写，句子结尾要加句号。例如：I am Ben. You are a visitor.
grammar.example: I am Ben. You are a visitor.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with am or are: I ____ happy.
Fill in the blank with am or are: You ____ my friend.
Which sentence has correct capital letters and period?
questions.explanation: 句首字母I要大写，句末要有句号。

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with am or are: I ____ a visitor.

speaking.part2: Describe a visitor at a help desk. You should say:
part3: Are you a visitor in a new place?
What do you say at a help desk?

transfer.writing: Write 2–8 simple sentences about yourself. Use 'I am' and 'You are'. Say your name and your room. Example: I am Li. I am at Room 3. You are a teacher.
